title: Which Shell?
lines: Nan has ten shells in a red sack.
"Which shell do you want?" she said.
Ted could not pick. He had to check them.
When he got a wet shell, a bug fell!
Ted let it fall. Nan did not yell.
"A bug would not want that," said Nan.
When Ted picks a shell, he checks it well.
Which shell did he pick? The thin red shell.

questions.ask: What falls out of the wet shell?
questions.listenFor: A bug. It is stated in the story - if they guess, send them back to that line.

questions.ask: Which shell does Ted pick in the end?
questions.listenFor: The thin red shell. It is the very last line, so have them reread it.

questions.ask: What do you think Nan meant about the bug? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea works, like "a bug does not want to be picked up." You are listening for a because.
